summary: Phase 1 (Wetworks rebrand + Excel export/import + Segments w/ behavioural filters) end-to-end testing. Backend pytest: 13/13 PASS covering /api/export/customers (xlsx 200 + correct content-type), /api/export/vehicles with make/year filters (xlsx), /api/import/customers (first import creates rows, re-import returns skipped_duplicates=2 as designed), /api/segments/preview with empty filter == total customers, min_total_spend=1000 returns 0, min_job_count=1 returns annotated rows (job_count/total_spend/last_service), last_service_after returns customers with completed jobs, segment CRUD (create→list→export xlsx→delete), and RBAC (sales 403 on DELETE, admin 200). Frontend smoke: Wetworks branding (login + sidebar logo + 'Wetworks' text), Customers page testids (export-customers-btn, import-customers-btn, customer-search, new-customer-btn, import-customers-file) all present, customers export downloaded customers_2026-05-04.xlsx successfully, Vehicles page filters (make/model/year/type/start/end + search + export) all present, vehicles export downloaded vehicles_2026-05-04.xlsx, Segments page with 'Toyota Owners' seed + Export/Delete actions, New Segment modal contains Vehicle Filters / Customer Filters / Behaviour Filters sections with all expected testids (filter-min-spend, filter-max-spend, filter-min-jobs, filter-max-jobs, filter-last-service-after, filter-last-service-before, preview-btn, save-segment-btn) and Preview Customers returns Matching:6 with NAME/MOBILE/CITY/JOBS/SPEND(KWD)/LAST SERVICE columns rendering correctly (verified via screenshot).

action_items: Optional polish: Auto-expand the Customers sidebar group when on /customers or /customers/segments routes so child links remain accessible; or have the toggle no-op when the active route is a child.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1516 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting (auth.py, customers.py, vehicles.py, jobs.py, quotations.py, reports.py, segments.py, export_import.py, seed.py).

_apply_segment_filters runs three sequential collection scans (customers → vehicles → jobs aggregation). For larger datasets consider a single $lookup-based aggregation; current design is fine for current seed scale.

Behavioural last_service is a $max over completed_at OR updated_at. updated_at gets bumped by ANY job mutation (e.g. payment/edit on an in-progress job), which can falsely satisfy last_service_after for not-yet-completed jobs. Recommend: $max over completed_at only and ignore non-completed jobs (or filter status==completed in the $match stage).
Import endpoint dedupes by mobile only; recommend trimming/normalising mobile (strip spaces, leading 0/+) and surfacing a row index in the success summary. errors[] only catches missing name/mobile.
Preferred contact normalisation falls back to 'mobile' silently when invalid — fine but consider logging.
/api/export/vehicles 'q' filtering is in-memory (post-fetch) with up to 20k docs; OK for now but document.
Customer create POST does not enforce mobile uniqueness even though import does — consider DB unique index on customers.mobile to make both consistent.
Segment delete is hard-delete with no audit; consider soft-delete (deleted_at) for traceability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical Phase-1 testids and downloads
